root_cause: The merchant is on a blended pricing model that overcharges relative to the true network cost.
diagnosis: Using a 2.0% blended rate versus the actual 1.75% network rate creates an excess fee of approximately Rs 4,989.21; this comparison is based on an illustrative benchmark model.
action_rationale: Switching to interchange‑plus pricing aligns fees with the underlying network cost, eliminating the overcharge.
